Callout.Name: Overdue Boat - Lake
Callout.Message: Boat overdue on the lake, trailer still at the slip.
Callout.Advisory: One boat, two on board, no radio contact.

Script.Line: The trailer is here and the boat is not.
They said two hours on the water. It has been five.
There is no radio on the boat. They never ran one.

Lines.Approach: The trailer is at the slip and the light went an hour ago.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
